title: Morin alleviates hepatic ischemia/reperfusion-induced mischief: In vivo and in silico contribution of Nrf2, TLR4, and NLRP3.
authors: Gendy, Abdallah; Elnagar, Mohamed R; Soubh, Ayman; Al-Mokaddem, Asmaa; El-Haddad, Alaadin; El-Sayed, Mohamed Kotb
one_liner_zh: 该文研究桑色素对肝缺血再灌注损伤的保护机制，涉及Nrf2/TLR4/NLRP3蛋白的分子对接，但核心是药物-蛋白互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: OBJECTIVE: Morin (MRN), a known natural flavonol, has demonstrated its shielding aptitude against ischemia/reperfusion (I/Re) lesion in various organs. Nonetheless, its potential influence on hepatic I/Re-induced injury modulation has not been fully elucidated. Consequently, the current study strived to investigate the mechanistic maneuvering of MRN against hepatic I/Re. Furthermore, the effects of MRN on Nrf2, TLR4, and NLRP3 proteins were evaluated via molecular docking studies. METHODS: For fulfilling this aim, Sprague-Dawley rats were allotted into 4 groups; Sham-operated (ShG), hepatic I/Re (30 min/24 h), and 10 days orally pre-treated MRN (50 and 100 mg/kg). KEY FINDINGS: MRN mechanistic maneuver disclosed its ability to safeguard the hepatocytes partially due to antioxidant aptitude through intensifying the expression/content of Nrf2/HO-1 trajectory accompanied by total antioxidant capacity boosting besides MDA lessening. In addition, MRN anti-inflammatory attribute was affirmed by downsizing the expression/content of TLR4/NF-kappaB trajectory accompanied by a sequent lessening of TNF-alpha, IL-1beta, IL-6, and ICAM-1 content. Moreover, MRN action entangled NLRP3 inhibitory character with subsequent MPO rebating. Furthermore, MRN anti-apoptotic trait verified by diminishing the pro-apoptotic and the executioner markers; Bax and caspase-3 levels, respectively. On the other hand, MRN administration proved its shielding action by improving the histopathological deterioration and lessening the serum ALT and AST levels. Finally, in silico studies exhibited moderate to promising binding affinities of MRN with the selected proteins ranging from -4.23 to -6.09 kcal mol(-1). CONCLUSION: Higher and lower doses of MRN purveyed plausible defensive mechanisms and abated episodes concomitant with hepatic I/Re mischief in part, by modifying oxidative status and in fl ammation by the impact on Nrf2/HO-1, TLR4/ NF-kappaB, and NLRP3 pathway.
abstract_zh: 目的：桑色素（MRN），一种已知的天然黄酮醇，已展示其对多种器官缺血/再灌注（I/Re）损伤的保护能力。然而，其对肝脏I/Re诱导损伤调节的潜在影响尚未完全阐明。因此，本研究旨在探讨MRN对抗肝脏I/Re的机制性调控。此外，通过分子对接研究评估了MRN对Nrf2、TLR4和NLRP3蛋白的影响。方法：为实现此目标，将Sprague-Dawley大鼠分为4组：假手术组（ShG）、肝脏I/Re组（30分钟/24小时），以及口服预给药MRN（50和100 mg/kg）10天组。主要发现：MRN的机制性调控显示其保护肝细胞的能力，部分归因于通过增强Nrf2/HO-1通路表达/含量、提升总抗氧化能力及降低MDA的抗氧化能力。此外，MRN的抗炎特性通过降低TLR4/NF-kappaB通路表达/含量及随之减少TNF-alpha、IL-1beta、IL-6和ICAM-1含量得到证实。同时，MRN作用涉及NLRP3抑制特性及随后的MPO降低。此外，MRN的抗凋亡特性通过减少促凋亡和效应标志物Bax和caspase-3水平得到验证。另一方面，MRN给药通过改善组织病理学恶化及降低血清ALT和AST水平证明了其保护作用。最后，计算机模拟研究显示MRN与所选蛋白的结合亲和力从中等到有前景，范围从-4.23到-6.09 kcal mol(-1)。结论：高剂量和低剂量的MRN提供了合理的防御机制，并通过影响Nrf2/HO-1、TLR4/NF-kappaB和NLRP3通路，部分减轻了与肝脏I/Re损伤相关的发作，通过调节氧化状态和炎症。
